en: Dependent on a state that is without conflict (*araṇa*) and limited (*paritta*), a state that is neither a refuge (*nasaraṇa*) nor limited arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and exalted (*mahaggata*), a state that is neither a refuge nor exalted arises by way of the root condition. Under the root condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and immeasurable (*appamāṇa*), a state that is neither a refuge nor immeasurable arises by way of the root condition. Under the root condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.
